question: A study is being conducted in a health center to determine the effect of exposure to tobacco smoke in children of smoking parents. For this purpose, a group of healthy children between 3 and 7 years old whose parents are smokers is selected and at the same time an equal number of children whose parents are non-smokers are selected in the same center. A year later, the appearance of respiratory diseases during that year will be investigated in both groups. Indicate the correct answer:

options.opa: The study design is a prospective cohort.
options.opb: The study design is cases and controls.
options.opc: The study design follows a qualitative methodology.
options.ope: The type of design used is efficient to study rare diseases.

analysis: The study design described involves selecting a group of children exposed to tobacco smoke (children of smoking parents) and comparing them to a group of children not exposed to tobacco smoke (children of non-smoking parents) to investigate the development of respiratory diseases over time. This aligns with the definition of a prospective cohort study where participants are followed over time to observe outcomes based on exposure status.
